metadata.title: Learned stabilization of incompressible flow: trained models and numerical evidence
metadata.description: Selected pressure-aware coefficient model, matched controls, saved training data and separately labeled experimental fixed-mesh response operators. Includes negative results and an independent finite binary64 linear-response certificate. Core FEM/fluid solver and training implementation are excluded. Saved-data replay does not reproduce native PDE execution.
